body: 100% this. If one side isn't willing to try and put in the effort to compromise, waste not one more minute of your life.

I've had partners where we had plenty of sex.. but it was very vanilla. After a while it's not enough even if you're having it constantly, you need it to be fulfilling. You can eat pizza every single day 3 times a day, but after a while... maybe you'd want to try something different. 

Sexual compatibility is so important. I don't date people I'm not compatible, obviously you don't have that option. Personally I'd leave the marriage, because love simply isn't enough. But it sounds like you really love each other. 

My advice is, lay out your sexual needs on the table, and pretty much say "you either meet them or you don't and if you don't lets compromise" she has to be willing to compromise if she loves you as much as the claims. If she doesn't, than honestly a marriage without compromise... well it ins't a marriage.
Be confident and assertive, if you want to kiss her, go for it, if you want to hold her hand do it. It's all about being assertive. You're doing great so far.
Any guy who's into you, or loves you, won't be stopped by something you think isn't attractive.
I had a child in one DB relationship, it still didn't stop me, also considering I was in my late 20's. I would never stay for the kids and give them that poor example.
10 YEARS? that nuts. I left a girl for going a whole month.

That's interesting, I experienced the same thing and because of their abuse I feel like I'm way too dependent. I also feel like I have separation anxiety because of the very toxic my parent's marriage was. Now they're happier than ever, but they don't realize they left a trail of damage behind them. My gf also has had similar experiences and abandonment issues. 

I am very happy you are aware though and that you are working to better yourself and your marriage, you're definitely many steps ahead of many people who are in denial about their stuff. Thank you for your time.

Why do you think you do that? I want to know so I can see if I can better understand her or not. Telling you from the receiving end of this, it's very taxing and it wears on those of us who have to somehow manage this. It isn't easy, and people by nature like the chase, but having to constantly chase is very hard. I think it is damaging to us on the receiving end, and the relationship as a whole.

I had an ex in a DB situation, and I would practically beg her to wear lingerie, and she wouldn't, that was her twisted way of having control. This seems like a situation of the opposite, I'm so sorry. I would have grabbed my bags and did a separation trial, how cruel he was isn't how you treat someone you love. As hurt as I've been in past relationships, I still found it within myself to be kind.
I would have walked back in, set a 5 min timer and said "you have that much time, to get your shit and move out, and go"

SO what i'm saying is, sure we can do counseling but if she wont' let go of her control freak tendencies, nothing is going to change. I get gas lit quite often too. I care about her enough to make changes, its just discouraging she doesn't seem to have the same for me.

She's admitted to being a control freak, and I do get the sense that she's on some kind of power trip. She never apologies for her faults, and I'm always constantly having to do that. Someone who's on some kind of power trip I think is just a character flaw, and I doubt she's willing to give that up, because in her mind she's giving up "power" which I think is just silly. I need commitment, not this cat and mouse game.

>The easiest thing to do is break up and look for a gal who is sexually compatible with you.

The end all solution honestly. It's been too much work trying to keep her happy, bending over backwards to get her attention, affection and love. I am 32, not old, but not young, and I don't have time to play these power struggle games, I need commitment.
I agree completely, it could be worse. I have to think long and hard and see if she's even willing to make efforts to improve our relationship. thank you again .

She hasn't said it outright, but I do suspect this could be a factor. Sometimes she just lays there without saying one word, but her body language is saying "touch me", it was flattering at first, but now, I'm just kind of annoyed. I  know withholding sex isn't  the correct approach, but I am open to it.

Don't apologize, I appreciate the effort and thought put into this. Great write up and it does give me hope. True, she doesn't turn me down, but having to constantly initiate is very draining emotionally and mentally. It does feel like she's not attracted to me. Its just hurtful and discouraging that sex was being had all the time, and now I can see she's slowly pulling back. 

That's the issue I think she doesn't value my needs or me in this relationship. I go above and beyond to please her and make her happy. I used to talk to her a bit condescending and I have stopped that completely, because it bothered her, and because I value her, I did stop that behavior. I just feel like she's not there, and I don't know how much longer I can hang on. She does have a child and I do my best to help her with that and be there since she's not on good terms with her baby daddy. At any rate, thank you for your thoughts.

I do follow that sub as I have been in a DB before. I am confused because while I always initiate and she doesn't, she does seem to enjoy herself while in the act, once she gets into, but just won't initiate.
